how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Four simple steps from search to advice.
how.step1Body: Filter lawyers by practice area, governorate, fee and earliest availability, and read reviews from real clients.
how.step2Body: Choose the consultation type and time, summarise your issue and attach documents securely.
how.step3Body: Pay through a licensed gateway. Bookings are only confirmed once our servers verify the payment.
how.step4Body: Join at the scheduled time, then follow notes, documents and your matter from your dashboard.

trust.title: Trust is a process, not a slogan
trust.subtitle: We built the platform to protect lawyer–client confidentiality.
trust.verificationBody: We review each lawyer's bar registration and professional documents before granting the verified badge. Lawyers cannot add it themselves.
trust.privacyBody: Only the parties and people you authorise can access your messages and documents — not even support staff can open them.
trust.paymentBody: Every transaction is recorded in a double-entry ledger, with a receipt, an invoice and a clear refund policy.
trust.reviewsBody: Reviews are only possible after a completed consultation or service, and we hold back any review that reveals confidential details.
